reviews.review:
No easy way to respec, I have anxiety when I try to spend my talents. So it's a 5.0001 / 10. Also progression seems to be a bit slow, it's a bit grindy.

EDIT: nvm progression is incredibly slow. It's just a grind. Honestly it's just better to join some high level players so they can carry me (and level up much faster)

The art is so cool, big fan.
The guns are great! Fun designs!
The bosses can be easy if your build is strong, and end your run instantly if you're "hoping" you get that auto aim beam gun later on. 
Needs an endless mode, and if there is one I just haven't played it yet. 
I want to be able to pick my own starting weapon when I've maxed out almost every character, it only...seems rewarding? I mean after 100+ hours...lol

On another note...


This game is probably great fun with people, but seeing as our world has created everything as a single player experience I've never played with anyone. I'm level 170 all single player. I play as the bunny because its literally the most overpowered character because of the combo with the beam gun. SERIOUSLY.  I don't even have to try at the game if I use the bunny and the auto aim beam gun. At the start of the game I used to aim for the head, try every new weapon, and play around with builds. Now I only play this insanely OP build.  Bunny with beam gun. I want more from this game, but when all of it is based on getting through the experience without dying we all just build the best we can find. I don't even proceed through a run without the auto aim beam gun, it's just that OP with the bunny.

Lvl 164 and the save resets. 81 hours of work gone. DO NOT BUY THIS GAME!!! Edit - I reached out on Discord 4 days ago per the dev comment and still havent heard from anyone.  Looks like support for this game is not good either.
reviews.developer_response: Hello and apologize for the unsatisfying experience. If you encounter the issue of save lost, please join our official discord channel (https://discord.com/invite/gunfire-reborn) where our devs are willing to help you out with it. Thank you for your understanding!
